tex_content.html:
For $t''\ge t'$, \[ w_{a,t'}(t'')=e^{-A(t'')} \left(a-2\pi \int _{t'}^{t''}e^{A(t)}\, dt\right). \] If $a'>a$, then \[ w_{a',t'}(t'')=w_{a,t'}(t'')+(a'-a)e^{-A(t'')}. \] \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch Multiply Equation (4) by $e^{A(t)}$ and integrate; the second identity is the difference of two solutions.

□

Lemma
[Families of short loops represent the trivial $\pi _3$ class]
